entities.name: Stanisław Ulam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Marcin Ulam was a Polish and, later an American mathematician who made important contribution in advancing the understanding of nuclear physics and computer science. He participated in the Manhattan Project, originated the Teller–Ulam design of thermonuclear weapons, discovered the concept of the cellular automaton, invented the Monte Carlo method of computation, and championed nuclear pulse propulsion. In pure and applied mathematics, he proved a number of theorems and proposed several conjectures.
